# Associate Professor Chamara Basnayake - Specialist Gastroenterologist & Endoscopist

> Academic gastroenterologist and endoscopist based in Melbourne, Australia. Specialist clinical care spanning disorders of gut-brain interaction (DGBI), oesophageal motility disorders, eosinophilic oesophagitis (EoE), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), coeliac disease, bowel cancer screening, and endoscopy.

## Clinical Overview & Qualifications
- **Name:** Associate Professor Chamara Basnayake
- **Title:** Consultant Gastroenterologist, Endoscopist, Associate Professor (University of Melbourne)
- **Qualifications:** MBBS (Hons) (Monash University), FRACP (Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians), PhD (University of Melbourne)
- **Subspecialty Training:** Advanced Fellowship in Oesophageal Motility Disorders at KU Leuven, Belgium
- **Key Appointments & Leadership:**
  - Clinical Lead, Oesophageal Physiology Laboratory at St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne
  - Co-founder, Multidisciplinary Functional Gut Disorders Clinic at St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne
  - PhD Committee Chair, Department of Surgery, University of Melbourne
  - Principal Investigator for clinical trials in Eosinophilic Oesophagitis (EoE) and Coeliac Disease
  - Recipient of the 2021 Ray Clouse Award (The Rome Foundation) and 2022 TJ Martin Award (St Vincent's Hospital)
  - Committee Member, Gastroenterological Society of Australia (GESA) Luminal Committee

## Areas of Clinical Practice
- **Disorders of Gut-Brain Interaction (DGBI):** Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), functional dyspepsia, chronic bloating, abdominal pain, and multidisciplinary treatment models.
- **Oesophageal Disorders & Motility:** High-resolution oesophageal manometry, gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD / GERD), dysphagia (swallowing difficulties), and achalasia.
- **Eosinophilic Oesophagitis (EoE):** Diagnostic assessment, dietary therapies, pharmacological treatment, and clinical trial participation.
- **Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD):** Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis management, multidisciplinary care, therapeutic monitoring, and microbiota-based therapies.
- **Coeliac Disease:** Serological and biopsy-based diagnosis, symptom evaluation, refractory cases, and trial options.
- **Endoscopic Procedures:** Diagnostic and therapeutic gastroscopy, colonoscopy, bowel cancer screening, and polyp surveillance.
- **Iron Deficiency & Anaemia:** Systematic clinical and endoscopic investigation of occult gastrointestinal blood loss.

## Referral Pathways for Medical Practitioners
- A valid GP or medical specialist referral is required for private consultation and Medicare rebates.
- **Direct / Open-Access Endoscopy:** Available for straightforward diagnostic gastroscopy and colonoscopy indications (positive FOBT, surveillance, iron deficiency).
- **Referral Submission:** Fax to (03) 9650 7910 or email to office@focusgastro.com.au.
